properties.name: camel.language.java.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the java language. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.language.java.pre-compile
properties.description: Whether the expression should be pre compiled once during initialization phase. If this is turned off, then the expression is reloaded and compiled on each evaluation.

properties.name: camel.language.java.resolve-resource
properties.description: Whether a result of the expression that is a String starting with resource: is loaded as a resource and its content becomes the result, e.g. a script that returns resource:file:order.json or resource:classpath:templates/order.json (a name without a scheme is a classpath resource). Off by default; the resource: prefix on the expression text itself is always resolved. Applies to the expression used as a value, not as a predicate.

properties.name: camel.language.java.single-quotes
properties.description: Whether single quotes can be used as replacement for double quotes. This is convenient when you need to work with strings inside strings.

properties.name: camel.language.java.trim
properties.description: Whether to trim the source code to remove leading and trailing whitespaces and line breaks.
